stories.title: Sources: NBA lacks proof Ballmer paid via firms
stories.summary: The NBA has found no evidence showing LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer funneled money through team sponsors to pay Kawhi Leonard, according to three people with knowledge of discussions between the two sides in recent days.

stories.title: Ohio State, Oregon start 1-2 in AP preseason poll
stories.summary: Ohio State and Oregon were 1-2 in the AP Top 25, giving the Big Ten Conference the top two teams in the preseason rankings for the first time in 65 years.

stories.title: Jets' Hall strains groin, but Glenn not worried
stories.summary: New York Jets running back Breece Hall strained his right groin in practice on Monday and will have tests to determine the severity of the injury, but coach Aaron Glenn says he didn't think Hall's injury is a big deal.

stories.title: New Heisman platform gives first vote to fans
stories.summary: The new team at Heisman has launched Heisman Hopefuls -- a data, storytelling and fan voting platform aimed at expanding the conversation about the award.

stories.title: Vikings lose Adams for season due to knee injury
stories.summary: The Minnesota Vikings, on Monday, placed veteran defender Jamal Adams on the season-ending injured list due to a right knee injury he suffered Saturday in the Vikings' 13-10 preseason win over the New York Giants.
